role: WorldClient.rand from the recording: a row's d.cw is the client world Random's seed * 31 + World.updateLCG (Rows.java), and the client never steps updateLCG, so two rows of one client world differ by 31 times the seed's advance; cwrand_recover solves step^K(s0) - s0 for the one seed and step count whose LCG value is an int, confirmed by a third row. test_snapshots seeds the client player's world Random with it at the bind (no snapshot carries it).
notes: Only the replay gate uses it (before the first tick); every recording under out/java/snapshots recovers its seed from rows t0-1..t0+1. A new WorldClient's Random (a dimension change) comes from its two seeder longs instead (player.c client_player_new_world_rand).
